description: Modular diff scanning missed calls that crossed formal in/out modes — fixed with formal-mode-aware call scanning; regression: verification_diff_modular_call.adb.

Redundant_Boolean_Comparison fired on a same-named enum literal instead of Standard.True/False — fixed by requiring the operand's type to resolve to Standard.Boolean; regression: redundant_boolean_comparison_clean.adb.

Dead_Store/Overwritten_Assignment/Repeated_Statement flagged writes to Volatile/Atomic/Address-clause hardware registers — fixed by exempting externally-observable objects; regression: volatile_register_writes_clean.adb.
Global/Depends/SPARK-readiness checks ignored an inherited SPARK_Mode => Off from an enclosing scope — fixed by walking up to that enclosing scope; regression: spark_mode_off_global_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output missed writes made via a nested subprogram's own Global contract listing the parameter as Output — fixed by consulting the callee's Global contract; regression: uninitialized_output_nested_call_clean.adb.
Depends contracts mishandled combined-output syntax "(A, B) => C", parsed as a nested aggregate — fixed by expanding that aggregate's associations; regression: depends_combined_output_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output flagged composite out parameters initialized field-by-field or element-by-element — fixed by unwrapping selected/indexed component prefixes; regression: uninitialized_output_composite_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output flagged out params forwarded positionally to an overloaded sibling when precise overload resolution failed — fixed by adding a lenient position-based fallback; regression: uninitialized_output_overloaded_forward_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output flagged scalar out params written unconditionally inside statically non-empty `for` loops — fixed by trusting the body's result when bounds are static and escape-free; regression: uninitialized_output_static_loop_clean.adb.

The FP-009 fix over-trusted a single indexed array write as covering the whole array — fixed by requiring a proven full-index-range write before trusting it; regression: uninitialized_output_array_loop_subtype_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output flagged an out parameter written via its own subprogram-name qualification ("Subp_Name.Param := ...") — fixed by recognizing that qualifier pattern; regression: uninitialized_output_own_name_qualifier_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output missed writes to out params forwarded as named actuals when Libadalang's resolution failed — fixed by adding a named-actual fallback resolver; regression: uninitialized_output_named_actual_forward_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output flagged out params initialized only via a parameterless prefixed call like "Queue.Clear;" — fixed by recognizing Dotted_Name call statements as writes; regression: uninitialized_output_prefixed_clear_clean.adb.

Wrong_Parameter_Mode recommended mode "out" for in-out parameters written only through a selected/indexed component — fixed by requiring a whole-object write for that recommendation; regression: wrong_parameter_mode_partial_write_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read misread an unrelated attribute like "Data'Last" as a read of a same-named local variable — fixed by excluding attribute designators from declaration matching; regression: uninitialized_read_attribute_designator_clean.adb.

Dead_Store flagged writes through a renaming of a longer-lived parameter/global field as dead — fixed by tracing the renamed object back to its base declaration; regression: dead_store_renaming_of_parameter_field_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read flagged reads inside a nested subprogram as preceding the enclosing subprogram's real initializing write, due to a purely textual AST walk — fixed by skipping recursion into nested subprogram/entry bodies; regression: uninitialized_read_nested_subprogram_order_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read missed genuine initializations via out/in-out actuals when Libadalang couldn't resolve the call — fixed by adding the same fallback resolvers used for Uninitialized_Output; regression: uninitialized_read_positional_forward_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read still misfired when even the fallback resolution failed in a deeper batch-provider context — fixed by treating an unresolved call's actual as an unknown boundary instead of continuing the scan; regression: uninitialized_read_unresolved_call_clean.adb.

--verify's initialization check misclassified renamings, defaulted composites, and address overlays as Definite_Error — fixed by propagating renaming state and handling address-clause objects conservatively; regression: verification_initialization_defaults_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output/Read flagged out params forwarded to a same-named sibling overload whenever one overload had a System.Address formal, due to misresolution — fixed by adding an arity-based candidate search; regression: uninitialized_output_overload_arity_fallback_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read flagged Import-aspect scalar overlays (populated by DMA/driver code, not Ada) as read before assignment — fixed by exempting externally-observable declarations; regression: uninitialized_read_import_overlay_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read missed an initializing write made via an out actual of a function called inside a larger expression — fixed by recursing into the RHS for call-based write detection; regression: uninitialized_read_function_out_actual_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read misread a called function's named-actual formal designator sharing a local variable's spelling as a self-read — fixed by excluding Param_Assoc designators from declaration matching; regression: uninitialized_read_named_actual_designator_clean.adb.

Wrong_Parameter_Mode recommended mode "in" for an in-out parameter actually written via a function call nested in an expression — fixed by recursing into the RHS for write detection; regression: wrong_parameter_mode_call_in_expression_clean.adb.

The analyzer's own "when others => null;" handler tripped its own Empty_Exception_Handler/Exception_Swallowed checks under self-analysis — fixed by replacing it with a logging call; a style fix with no dedicated fixture.

Uninitialized_Output/Read and related checks missed reads/writes made through an access-to-subprogram-typed component or discriminant call — fixed by resolving the indirect callable's own profile before the arity fallback; regression: access_to_subprogram_actuals_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Read flagged a variable named in "pragma Unreferenced (X);" right after its declaration as a read — fixed by excluding Unreferenced/Unmodified/Warnings pragma arguments from declaration matching; regression: uninitialized_read_pragma_unreferenced_clean.adb.

A plain subtype of a scalar type from a with'd, externally defined package (e.g. "subtype T_Int16 is Interfaces.Integer_16;") makes Libadalang's own property implementation raise Property_Error ("dereferencing a null access") whenever ordinary semantic analysis needs that subtype's privacy/type, silently suppressing the checks that depend on the result. Confirmed via symbolic backtraces (temporary GNAT.Traceback.Symbolic instrumentation) from two structurally unrelated call sites, both bottoming out in the identical Libadalang chain inside vendored libadalang-implementation.adb: Subtype_Decl_P_Get_Type -> Base_Subtype_Decl_P_From_Type_Bound -> Base_Subtype_Decl_P_Is_Private -> Base_Type_Decl_P_Next_Part -> Raise_Property_Exception. The first site is Subprogram_Summaries.Register_Body's Body.P_Decl_Part, resolving a subprogram body's separately declared spec to build its interprocedural effect summary; when it fails, no summary is registered for that subprogram, so callers lose its May_Read/May_Write/May_Block/May_Raise effects for every check that consults summaries. The second is SPARK_Readiness.Check_Discriminant_Access's ordinary name resolution on an unrelated Dotted_Name, which is silently skipped for that node. This is an upstream Libadalang defect, not an AdaLang Analyzer logic error, and there is no fix available on this side of the boundary; both call sites already contain the failure correctly via their existing "when others" handler (skip and log via Log_Verbose_Once, keep going) rather than aborting the run, but the net effect is a real, currently open coverage gap. Originally observed in AdaCore/Certyflie, crazyflie_support/src/types.ads ("subtype T_Int32 is Interfaces.Integer_32;" and three siblings among its T_IntNN/T_UintNN block); reduced to a minimal single-file case. Covered by external_subtype_signature_match_robustness.adb and a CLI-robustness check in run_cli_robustness.sh confirming the run still completes and reports its unrelated, genuine Unused_Parameter finding rather than aborting. Re-investigated with an eye toward a local fix, with two further findings. First, Register_Body's own fallback (use Subprogram itself as the key declaration when P_Decl_Part fails) was unreachable for exactly this failure, because a Property_Error raised while elaborating a declare block's own declarative part is not handled by that block's own handlers (RM 11.2); it escaped past the intended narrow handler to Register_Body's coarser outer one, discarding the whole summary instead of falling back. Fixed by assigning Decl_Part in the executable part instead (a genuine, narrow correctness improvement, kept independently of this issue), but it does not close the gap: the fallback path (Declaration_Name on the body, which must itself mangle Foo's parameter types into a unique name) requires the identical broken property and fails the same way one step later, confirming no cheap workaround exists on this side. Second, the failure's true trigger has now been isolated and is fully deterministic (an earlier note here, since corrected, mistook inconsistent PATH exports across separate manual test invocations for genuine Libadalang non-determinism): both Libadalang.Auto_Provider (used for -P and project-less runs alike) and its Libadalang.Unit_Files.Default_Provider fallback resolve with'd units, including Interfaces, purely through GNATCOLL.Projects, which shells out to "gnatls -v" to locate the default runtime's predefined source path; -P only contributes source-file discovery via GPR2 and does not feed the project's own runtime into this lookup. Without a "gnatls" on PATH, the lookup finds nothing, Interfaces is entirely unresolved, and the property chain above dereferences null every time instead of degrading gracefully; with a real GNAT toolchain on PATH, the same binary against the same input never fails (confirmed 20/20 clean vs. 20/20 failing in controlled, single-shell-invocation batches). Since there is still no way to make the affected checks succeed without a real GNAT toolchain present, Adalang_Analyzer now warns at startup (Adalang_Analyzer_CLI, gated on Locate_Exec_On_Path ("gnatls")) so the condition is visible instead of a silent, scattered coverage gap; run_cli_robustness.sh's check tolerates either outcome, since it should pass regardless of whether the invoking environment happens to have a toolchain on PATH. Partial mitigation added: since "alr exec -- which gnatls" resolved a cached toolchain that bare PATH did not, most of the remaining exposure was invocations of an alr-built binary run directly instead of through "alr exec", not a genuinely toolchain-less machine. Adalang_Analyzer_CLI.Locate_Alire_Gnatls_Dir now reads Alire's own global settings.toml for the selected gnat toolchain and, when found, self-augments PATH with that toolchain's bin/ directory before the gnatls check runs, so this common case no longer needs "alr exec" wrapping at all (confirmed: the warning no longer fires and external_subtype_signature_match_robustness.adb resolves cleanly under a stripped PATH with only HOME set). This does not close the issue: a machine with no Alire-managed toolchain anywhere (e.g. a bare binary copied to a box that never ran "alr build" locally) still hits the underlying Libadalang defect exactly as described above. The Alire PATH-fallback behavior above (both directions: fallback succeeds from a real $HOME's settings.toml, and the warning still fires with no Alire settings present at all) had only ever been confirmed by hand; this is now automated in tests/run_alire_gnatls_fallback.sh, added to tests/run_all.sh, so a future change to Locate_Alire_Gnatls_Dir cannot silently regress either direction (verified the negative direction of the new test actually fails when the fallback call is disabled, then confirmed the fix restores it). The underlying upstream Libadalang defect itself remains unreported to AdaCore/libadalang as of this writing, despite a fully isolated, deterministic, minimal repro being available in the fixture referenced above.

Uninitialized_Read flagged a variable as read before assignment whenever Libadalang's resolution failed elsewhere in the subprogram, since write-detection had no fallback — fixed by reusing the existing spelling-based read fallback for writes too; no fixture named.

--verify's initialization check could keep a stale Definite_Error recorded from an intermediate, non-converged CFG state instead of the fixed point's final Unproved result — fixed by adding a Final replay pass after convergence; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_initialization.adb.
The FP-031 staleness bug also affected pragma Assert/Loop_Invariant assertion-check recording — fixed with the same Final-replay pattern; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_assert.adb.

The same staleness bug affected Precondition_Check, recorded under two separate stable IDs per call — fixed by replaying both IDs on the Final pass; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_precondition.adb.

The same staleness bug affected Range_Check, letting a stale pre-loop value falsely prove a range check safe — fixed with the same Final-replay pattern; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_range.adb.
The same staleness bug affected Index_Check — fixed with the same Final-replay pattern; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_index.adb.
The same staleness bug affected Division_By_Zero_Check — fixed with the same Final-replay pattern; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_division.adb.
The same staleness bug affected Integer_Overflow_Check — fixed with the same Final-replay pattern; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_overflow.adb.

Report_Violation_At had no deduplication, so a violation revisited during CFG convergence (or a chained and/or operator sharing one location) was reported repeatedly — fixed by adding a matching-tuple dedup check; regression: tests/verification_loop_stale_range_check.adb.

--verify's initialization check misread a nested subprogram's Global aspect naming a variable as an executable read, reporting Definite_Error ahead of the real later assignment — fixed by skipping Aspect_Spec nodes during finalization; regression: tests/verification_global_aspect_reference_clean.adb.

A Property_Error from certain Libadalang calls during proof-obligation finalization aborted the whole file instead of just that obligation — fixed by wrapping the per-node dispatch so only the affected node's obligations are skipped; regression: tests/verification_cross_project/.

Non_Short_Circuit_Condition suggested "and then"/"or else" for non-Boolean (e.g. modular/bitwise) "and"/"or" operands, which isn't legal Ada — fixed by gating the suggestion on the operand resolving to Standard.Boolean; regression: tests/non_short_circuit_modular_clean.adb.

Circular_Package_Dependency treated a "limited with" edge the same as an ordinary with, flagging Ada's sanctioned mutual-type idiom as a cycle — fixed by building edges only from non-limited with clauses; regression: tests/circular_dependency_limited_with_a.ads/_b.ads.

--verify's initialization check treated a pragma Unreferenced argument as a genuine read, the same gap FP-028 fixed elsewhere — fixed by adding the same pragma-argument guard to the bounded verifier's own walk; regression: tests/verification_initialization_pragma_unreferenced_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output's overload-forwarding fallback could still land on the wrong same-named overload or miss a lexically-later sibling overload — fixed by rejecting candidates with too few formals and no longer filtering out later-declared overloads; regression: uninitialized_output_overload_defaulted_trailing_clean/guard.adb.

Reversed_Range flagged Ada's common empty-range idiom "Low .. Low - 1" (e.g. "1 .. 0") as a swapped-bounds typo — fixed by excluding ranges exactly one short of empty; regression: tests/precision_reversed_range_empty_idiom_clean.adb.

--verify's own (separate) initialization-check code path still misreported the FP-011 own-name-qualification write ("Subp_Name.Param := ...") as unwritten — fixed by adding the matching suffix-climbing case to the bounded verifier; regression: tests/verification_own_name_qualifier.adb.

--verify's SMT bridge never translated "/", "mod", or "rem" to SMT-LIB, leaving dependent proofs unattempted — fixed by adding Euclidean div/mod/rem translation guarded on a provably-nonzero divisor; regression: tests/verification_vc_division.adb.

The SMT bridge had no translation for function calls, type conversions, or quantified expressions, leaving many proofs unattempted — fixed by adding conservative inlining of expression-function calls plus conversions and range-quantified expressions; regression: tests/verification_vc_call_inlined.adb.

The overflow check resolved a derived type's base range via one P_Base_Type hop, using a narrower parent constraint instead of the true machine base range — fixed by walking to P_Root_Type instead; regression: tests/verification_vc_derived_overflow_base.adb.

The loop-variant-progress check required its Loop_Invariant to textually precede the Loop_Variant pragma, missing the equally legal reverse order — fixed by reusing the existing order-tolerant leading-pragma check; regression: tests/verification_vc_variant_leading_invariant_order.adb.

Reraise_Discards_Occurrence flagged an enrich-and-reraise ("raise Foo with "<msg>";") the same as a bare re-raise that discards the exception — fixed by exempting raises with a non-null error message; regression: tests/precision_reraise_discards_occurrence_enriched_message_clean.adb.

Duplicate_Subprogram's message cited only the matched location's bare filename, making two identically-named files in different directories look like self-duplicates — fixed by reporting the full filename; regression: tests/duplicate_subprogram_cross_file (variant_a/variant_b).

Exception_Propagation's boundary walk stopped only at subprogram bodies, so a task body nested in an outer guarded block wrongly inherited that outer handler as its boundary — fixed by also stopping at task bodies; regression: tests/precision_exception_propagation_task_guard.adb.

Address_Clause matched only the "for X'Address use ...;" attribute-clause form, missing the equivalent "with ..., Address => ...;" aspect form — fixed by also matching Address aspect associations; regression: tests/precision_address_clause_aspect_finding.adb.
Address_Clause also missed the obsolescent "for X use at ADDR;" representation clause — fixed by adding an Ada_At_Clause case; regression: tests/precision_address_clause_at_finding.adb.

Null_Case_Alternative flagged deliberate no-op case alternatives, including "when others => null;" and named-choice fallthrough idioms — fixed by exempting others-alternatives and suppressing the remaining cases inline; regression: tests/precision_null_case_alternative_others_clean.adb.

Empty_Elsif_Body flagged the same deliberate no-op idiom found for Null_Case_Alternative (FP-056), spelled with elsif — fixed with an inline suppression comment, since elsif has no others-equivalent to exempt; no dedicated fixture.

A --baseline fingerprint instability made an unchanged Duplicate_Subprogram finding look new whenever unrelated code shifted the earlier occurrence's line number embedded in the hashed message — fixed by moving that location into the unhashed evidence field; regression: tests/run_clone_detection.sh.

Empty_Else_Body and four sibling empty-body checks sharing one helper treated a solitary "pragma Assert (False);" as non-substantive filler, the same as a null statement — fixed by special-casing pragma Assert as substantive; regression: precision_empty_*_pragma_assert_clean.adb fixtures.

Unclosed_File_Handle pessimistically assumed a missing else branch left a file open, misfiring on the standard idempotent-close (Is_Open) guard and a symmetric boolean-guarded open/close pair — fixed by recognizing both guard idioms structurally; regression: tests/precision_unclosed_file_handle_clean.adb.

--verify's loop-variant-progress check reported Definite_Error on a correct 'Succ-based loop counter, because missing 'Succ/'Pred translation collapsed before/after terms into a tautology — fixed by adding 'Succ/'Pred SMT translation and an equal-terms guard; regression: tests/verification_loop_variant_succ.adb.
